_comment_media: Each project reads its visuals from images/projects/<slug>/. Drop files in, number them to set the order (01-, 02-, ...). The first file is the hero. Video (.mp4 .webm .mov) autoplays muted on loop; images rotate as a carousel. An empty folder renders a typographic card instead of a broken image, so a project can go live before its visuals exist.
_comment_clients: Client names deliberately never appear here. Named clients live in data/clients.json and are shown only as the logo strip — the two are never connected.

projects.title: Real-Time Vision-Based Coconut Counting
projects.cardLine: Vision-based counting and automated conveyor regulation on a production line.
body: A vision-based counting system installed over a production conveyor. Coconuts are detected and tracked in real time under controlled lighting, with the running count displayed at the line.

Operators set a target quantity and conveyor speed is regulated automatically to meet it. A connected web interface holds full count history and trend analysis, providing per-shift and per-batch visibility.

projects.title: Smart Shelf Automation
projects.cardLine: Weight-sensing retail shelving with automated product advertising and consumption analytics.
body: Weight-based sensing beneath each shelf row measures remaining units continuously. Removal of a unit triggers product-specific advertising on an adjacent display.

The system supports multiple products within a single row and scales across a retail floor. An analytics backend provides restock recommendations, consumption forecasting, and analysis of demand peaks and trends.

projects.title: Automated Liquid Level Monitoring
projects.cardLine: Continuous tank level monitoring engineered for beverage production conditions.
body: Sensor-based monitoring of liquid levels across a beverage manufacturing facility, providing continuous visibility in place of manual inspection.
Units are waterproofed and constructed to hold calibration under sustained high temperature and heavy machine vibration.

projects.title: Facility Layout Design and 3D Modelling
projects.cardLine: Engineering-level 3D model and full 2D layouts for a manufacturing facility.
body: Engineering-level 3D modelling and 2D floor layouts for a manufacturing facility, supporting space management, operational flow and future system integration.

The work included internal partitioning across office and production areas, with doors, windows and access points, along with a front yard remodel and a front wall design aligned to the company's corporate identity.

projects.title: Vehicle-Mounted Electronic Enclosure Design
projects.cardLine: IP65 electronic enclosure engineered for vehicle-interior heat and sunlight.
body: Custom electronic enclosure for a vehicle-mounted system, with 3D CAD design and mounting for the PCBs, sensors, batteries and accessories it houses.
Rated IP65 and made from a UV-resistant engineering thermoplastic, with thermal analysis confirming performance under intermittent exposure up to 70°C.
